rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for wisdom, including spiritual wisdom when the context is religious.

example.english: People with wisdom don't act impulsively when they face major problems.
example.traditional: 有智慧嘅人，遇到大事都唔會衝動。
example.jyutping: jau5 zi3 wai6 ge3 jan4 jyu6 dou3 daai6 si6 dou1 m4 wui5 cung1 dung6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the ability to judge situations and make sound decisions.

example.english: Buying a home is such a big matter—you need wisdom and can't just listen to what people say.
example.traditional: 買樓咁大件事，要有判斷力，唔可以淨係聽人講。
example.jyutping: maai5 lau4 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6 jiu3 jau5 pun3 dyun6 lik6 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 teng1 jan4 gong2

rows.note: Use this for a piece of good or wise advice rather than for wisdom as a personal quality.

example.english: I have always kept my teacher's wisdom in my heart.
example.traditional: 老師嘅良言，我一直記喺心入面。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 ge3 loeng4 jin4 ngo5 jat1 zik6 gei3 hai2 sam1 jap6 min6
